fields.operator: Calloway Cruise Line · MV Harbor Lantern
body: Some guests and crew have had stomach illness during this voyage. We have reported the cases to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, as we are required to do, and we are working with them.
Your health and comfort come first. This letter tells you what we are doing and how you can help.
steps: Wash your hands with soap and water often, and always before eating and after using the restroom.
If you have vomiting or diarrhea, call the medical center at 4-1000 and stay in your cabin until 24 hours after your symptoms end.
Use the served food lines in the buffet; staff will plate your meal.
whatWeAreDoing: Increased cleaning and disinfection of public areas and high-touch surfaces
Ill crew kept off duty until cleared by our doctor
Served meals in place of self-service
fields.offer: Every guest on this voyage will receive a 25 percent credit toward a future cruise.
fields.contact: Guest Services desk, Deck 5, open 24 hours · cabin phone 4-2000
fields.signer: Captain Elias Brandt, Master; Maren Okoye, Hotel Director
